newsitem.title: USA: OccuSystems to offer $85 million in notes.
newsitem.headline: OccuSystems to offer $85 million in notes.

text.p: OccuSystems Inc Wednesday said it will perform a private placement of $85 million in six percent convertible subordinated notes, due in 2001.
After the 90th day following the latest day of initial issuance of the notes, the notes will be convertible into common stock at $29.70 per share.

OccuSystems said it has granted the initial purchasers in the offering a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase an additional $12.75 million in principal amount of such notes. The company intends to use the proceeds of the offering to repay bank indebtedness incurred in connection with acquisitions and for general corporate purposes, including the funding of potential future acquisitions.
